top_findings.title: PUT /books/{id} echoes "id":0 instead of the updated book's id
top_findings.evidence: main.go:248 decodes the request body into a fresh Book (ID zero-valued) and main.go:277 encodes that same value back; book.ID is never assigned from the path id. The path id reaches only the UPDATE statement (main.go:118-122). A client PUTting {"title":..,"author":..} to /books/1 receives {"id":0,...}. main_test.go:162-173 asserts title/author/year/isbn on the update response but never ID, so the tests pass over it.
top_findings.suggestion: Set book.ID = id before encoding (or re-read the row via store.GetBookByID(id)), and assert the ID in the update test.
